title: Island Hopping from Split by Kayak: Three Days, One Smug Dolphin
description: You can do the Dalmatian islands by ferry like everyone else, or you can paddle out of Split and have every pebble cove to yourself before the tour boats arrive. A three-day sea kayak route via Šolta and back — where to wild camp legally, the afternoon maestral wind that actually dictates your schedule, and the dolphin that escorted us into Maslinica looking unbearably pleased with itself.

comments.comment: The maestral warning is real — we ignored it once and spent four hours doing what the morning would've done in one. Great route.
